## Tour highlights

Get to know Colombia’s history in Bogotá through La Candelaria, the Gold Museum, the Casa de la Moneda and the Botero Museum. The city sits high in the Andes, and the view from Monserrate is one of the first standout moments of the trip.

In the Coffee Region, see how coffee grows on mountain slopes, take part in picking the crop and watch the beans being dried and roasted. Then try coffee prepared right on the farm. Nearby are the Cocora Valley, with its wax palms, and the colourful town of Salento.

Cartagena brings together old fortification walls, colonial mansions and the Caribbean Sea. After the sightseeing days, you have three days on San Andrés to relax by the water.

In Medellín, the itinerary returns to city tours, museums and Colombian history before taking you to El Peñón de Guatapé. The final full sightseeing day is devoted to the legend of El Dorado, Lake Guatavita and the Salt Cathedral of Zipaquirá.
